issues.description: Visibility mismatch for the Farm.animals attribute: the problem statement's UML and task text indicate a private animals attribute with getter and setter, but the provided solution declares animals as public. This contradicts the intended encapsulation in the specification and may confuse students about the expected visibility and implementation (they are instructed to implement getter/setter for a private field).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the animals attribute private in the implementation (e.g. private List<Animal> animals;) and keep the public getAnimals()/setAnimals(...) methods as the way to access it. Update the solution and template Farm.java accordingly so they match the UML and the task instructions about encapsulation.
